app_info.subtitle: Compress and convert images
app_info.description: Tinify helps users compress, resize, crop, and convert attached PNG, JPEG, WebP, and AVIF images. It returns the processed image through a temporary download link with exact before-and-after byte counts, dimensions when available, and an honest optimized status.

justifications.read_only_justification: Uploads the attached image and creates a private, expiring Tinify processing result that consumes one account operation.
justifications.open_world_justification: The result remains private and temporary and cannot publish or change publicly visible internet content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite the user's original image or any persistent account data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Uploads the attached image and creates a private, expiring resized result that consumes one account operation.
justifications.open_world_justification: The resized result remains private and temporary and is not published to the public internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not replace or delete the user's original image or other persistent data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Uploads the attached image and creates a private, expiring cropped result that consumes one account operation.
justifications.open_world_justification: The cropped result remains private and temporary and cannot alter publicly visible content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not overwrite or delete the original image or any persistent user data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Uploads the attached image and creates a private, expiring converted result that consumes one account operation.
justifications.open_world_justification: The converted result remains private and temporary and is not published to an external audience.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not overwrite or delete the original image or other persistent account data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the authenticated Tinify account's current plan and operation usage.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not create, send, publish, or change content in any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or otherwise mutate account data.

test_cases.description: Compress an attached PNG and report exact savings.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Tinify to compress this attached PNG for the web. Show the original size, result size, and percentage saved.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns original and result byte counts, the percentage change, optimized status, and a temporary result download link; if the image cannot be reduced, clearly says to keep the original.

test_cases.description: Resize an attached JPEG to an exact width.
test_cases.user_prompt: Resize this attached JPEG to 1200 pixels wide while keeping its aspect ratio, and report the final dimensions and size change.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a 1200-pixel-wide result with final dimensions, before-and-after byte counts, percentage change, and a temporary download link.

test_cases.description: Crop an attached screenshot to a specified rectangle.
test_cases.user_prompt: Crop this attached screenshot from x 0 and y 0 to a 1200 by 630 pixel rectangle.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the cropped image through a temporary download link and reports the crop rectangle and byte-size change.

test_cases.description: Convert an attached PNG to WebP.
test_cases.user_prompt: Convert this attached PNG to WebP using best quality and tell me whether the result is smaller.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a WebP result link with the suggested file name, exact before-and-after byte counts, and percentage change, including an honest increase if the result is larger.

test_cases.user_prompt: How many Tinify operations have I used and how many remain in the current billing period?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the plan, billing period, included operations, used operations, and remaining operations.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke image tools for unsupported PDF compression.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Compress this attached PDF with Tinify.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explains that Tinify supports PNG, JPEG, WebP, and AVIF images and does not invoke a tool for the PDF.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Tinify for image generation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Generate a new watercolor landscape image from this description.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not invoke Tinify because the app processes existing images and does not generate new images.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not fetch an arbitrary image URL as an attachment substitute.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Compress the image at https://example.com/photo.png with Tinify.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Asks the user to attach the image instead of invoking Tinify with an arbitrary remote URL.
